top_categories.workout_context: 10,991ft of climbing makes aerobic ceiling relevant when the grade or pace changes. VO2max work supports those hard moments; sustained climbing and conservative pacing remain the spine.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Galibier Challenge's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before June.

Galibier Challenge's high-Alpine paved climbing rewards road-specific control. Practice smooth gear and cadence changes, accelerate deliberately out of corners, and settle quickly back into sustainable power for 68 miles.
At Galibier Challenge, changes in grade or pace can lift effort above threshold before it settles again. Over-unders train that transition while you keep riding.
161ft/mi signals a climbing-heavy course. Sustained sub-threshold and threshold work builds the steady power needed without turning the opening climb into the day’s hardest effort.
10,991ft of climbing on grades that change every minute. You need to switch from seated to standing without losing rhythm.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Galibier Challenge. Train it until it feels boring.
68 miles on high-Alpine paved climbing burns energy faster than the distance suggests. Train the fade resistance now.
Brief efforts above sustainable power can come from grade changes, positioning, or closing a gap at Galibier Challenge. Train them without letting those efforts derail the longer pacing plan.
Low-cadence force work supports 10,991ft of climbing when the grade lowers cadence. Practice controlled torque while preserving good form.
Base fitness for Galibier Challenge. Without this, the hard workouts break you down instead of building you up.
Steeper ramps, positioning, or pace changes on high-Alpine paved climbing can demand short hard efforts. Practice them without compromising the sustained work that defines the course.

race_overlay.nutrition: Use training to rehearse an eating and drinking plan for Galibier Challenge's 68 miles. Start early, use products you tolerate, and carry enough between the organizer’s confirmed resupply points.
race_overlay.altitude: Galibier Challenge with 10,991ft of climbing finishes high enough for reduced oxygen availability to affect sustainable power, pacing, and recovery. Use a conservative upper-mountain pacing plan, test any travel or acclimatization strategy before the event, and plan layers for changing conditions. Do not begin iron or other supplements without clinician-guided testing.
race_overlay.terrain: The course profile at Galibier Challenge rewards specific practice. Include regular rides on high-alpine paved climbing to build confidence.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on VO2max, Race Simulation, and Road Specific to prepare you for 68 miles of high-alpine paved climbing in Saint-Michel-de-Maurienne, Savoie, France.
